caption: A phone charger is plugged into a worn socket, and a small spark flashes at the plug as it goes in.

sa.check: A phone charger with its plug, and a wall socket.
The plug is pushed into the socket.
A small spark flashes at the plug as it goes in.
The socket looks worn: scuffed, loose or discoloured.
The spark comes as the prongs enter, not before.

pc.expect: The spark is a single brief flash at the socket as the prongs make contact, and is gone; nothing glows afterwards.
pc.fail: The spark glows on at the socket after the plug is seated; or sparks appear while the plug is still held away from the wall; or sparks keep flashing with the plug seated and untouched; or the flash appears on the cord or the charger body.

pc.expect: One plug, one cord, one socket; the plug goes in whole and the spark leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the socket vanishes or moves along the wall; or a glowing dot stays on the socket after the flash; or the cord splits.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall from the socket and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise from the socket and gather above it; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the floor for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: Once seated, the charger works: its indicator light, if it has one, comes on and stays on.
pc.fail: The charger's indicator light comes on while the plug is still clear of the wall; or the indicator flickers on and off with the plug seated and untouched; or the indicator lights and then goes dark for the rest of the clip while the plug stays in.
pc.precondition: The charger has an indicator light in view.

pc.expect: The prongs enter the socket's holes; the plug and hand pass through nothing; the charger keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The plug passes into the wall beside the socket; or fingers pass through the plug or the wall; or the charger changes shape; or the plug merges with the socket.

pc.expect: The charger's colour, the cord and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The charger changes colour; or the cord changes colour or thickness; or the wall changes colour.
